subject: Clearpath: regional sanction and private-link evidence request
messages:
From: Aisha Mensah <aisha.m@clearpathtx.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: security+compliance@clearpathtx.com
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Region confirmation + PrivateLink controls — Clearpath security pack request

Hi Ben,

We are finalizing the cloud security review for our pilot and need formal confirmation of a few items before our legal/compliance sign-off:  

1) Data residency guarantee: can Redwood provide a signed statement confirming that production customer workloads for our org will be hosted within US-only regions (no cross-border failover to EU/APAC)?
2) Private connectivity: we need a diagram and short runbook that shows PrivateLink/privatelink-equivalent connectivity (peering, IP ranges, who terminates TLS) between our VPC and Redwood's private endpoints.
3) Key custody: do you support a customer-managed KMS key (BYOK/HSM) for encryption-at-rest for the dedicated deployment? If not, what are the controls and rotation cadence?
4) Artifacts: SOC 2 summary, CAIQ slice for hosting, and any region-binding letter you can sign.

Timeline: we are aiming to get these into our evidence folder by EOD Thu 2 Sep so legal can proceed to procurement the following week.

Can you confirm what you can provide and expected delivery times? If helpful, happy to hop on a quick call this week — our security lead (cc) is available Wed/Thu afternoon EDT.

Thanks,

Aisha Mensah
Head of Security Operations
Clearpath Therapeutics
(Attachment: security_questionnaire_v2.xlsx)
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Mensah <aisha.m@clearpathtx.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Region confirmation + PrivateLink controls — Clearpath security pack request

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front, and then a plan:  

1) Data residency: yes — for Dedicated and Private deployments you can pin to US-only zones. We will provide a signed region-binding letter that commits to US-only hosting for your production partition. The letter will include our fallback policy (we do not perform cross-border failover without prior written consent).

2) Private connectivity: we have a standard PrivateLink topology for Dedicated customers. I attached a high-level topology image and a short runbook (see attachments). The runbook shows who terminates TLS (Redwood edge/load balancer in your VPC peering case), IP ranges, and handshake steps for establishing the private endpoint.

3) Key custody: we support customer-managed keys via KMS in our Private offer (BYOK). For Dedicated, we provide X.509-based HSM-backed key import and a rotation cadence up to the customer (we rotate default keys quarterly if you opt-in). I'll have Olga include the KMS bullet points and the CAIQ controls mapping for key custody.

4) Artifacts: attaching a SOC 2 executive summary and a draft region-binding letter for your review. We can DocuSign the final letter.

Plan/next steps:  
- I will loop in Olga to confirm the CAIQ slice and the specific KMS statements by Mon 31 Aug.
- We will prepare the signed region letter and upload to the Drive link by Thu 2 Sep EOD.
- If you'd like a 30-minute tech walkthrough of the privatelink runbook and IP allowlist steps I'll set that up Wed/Thu afternoon EDT as you suggested.

Best,

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Healthcare
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: privatelink_topology_overview.png, redwood_region_sanction_letter_draft.pdf, SOC2-Summary-2025.pdf)
From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Mensah <aisha.m@clearpathtx.com>, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Region confirmation + PrivateLink controls — CAIQ and KMS details

Hi Aisha / Ben — looping in on the controls detail. Per Ben's summary, a few clarifications for your evidence folder:  

- CAIQ/Hosting slice: we will produce a CAIQ slice focused on network segmentation, VPC peering/privatelink controls, keystore management, and operational boundary. That will include the specific control IDs you asked for (e.g., CCM 13.1 network segmentation notes).
- KMS/BYOK: for Private we support customer-managed keys (import via standard HSM import; we support AWS KMS and Vault-based HSM connectors). For Dedicated we can arrange either customer-held key material or a delegated HSM cluster; rotation cadence is configurable and we will document the rotation schedule in the runbook. We will also include our key compromise response steps and proof of periodic key rotation testing.
- Implementation note: the Private offer puts the control plane (management plane) in a customer-managed VPC in your account for air-gapped deployments. If you choose the VPC-hosted control plane option, that will be reflected in the CAIQ slice and the region-binding letter.

Deliverables and ETA: 
- CAIQ hosting slice PDF: Tue 1 Sep 2026 EOD
- Final region-binding letter (signed): Thu 2 Sep 2026 EOD (DocuSign link to follow)
- Privatelink runbook (detailed): Wed 1 Sep 2026 morning

If you want any specific artifacts (e.g., sample KMS import logs, rotation test reports), call that out and we will add them to the evidence folder.

Cheers,
Olga Petrov
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: none)
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Mensah <aisha.m@clearpathtx.com>
Cc: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Region confirmation + PrivateLink controls — Clearpath security pack request (final artifacts)

Aisha — attaching the requested artifacts and the signed letter (DocuSign). Sorry for the last-mile delay — we wanted to include the CAIQ slice and the KMS notes. Quick summary of what's in the Drive folder:  

- redwood_region_sanction_letter.pdf (signed via DocuSign) — commits Redwood to US-only hosting for Clearpath production workloads unless written consent is provided for a change.
- privatelink_topology_overview.png — high-level diagram showing the private endpoint, TLS termination point, and IP ranges.
- privatelink_runbook.pdf — step-by-step handshake, allowlist instructions, NAT/route table notes, and escalation contacts.
- CAIQ_hosting_slice.pdf — abbreviated CAIQ answers focusing on residency, keystore, and network segregation controls.
- SOC2-Summary-2025.pdf — executive SOC 2 summary and how our controls map to the CAIQ slice.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/example-clearpath-region-letter
Drive evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleClearpathEvidence

If you need any of the artifacts notarized or additional operation-runbooks (e.g., runbook for failover tests), Olga and I can add those to the folder. Otherwise happy to schedule the technical handoff call to walk your infra and network teams through the runbook — Marissa, can you coordinate Wednesday 9 Sep for that?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Healthcare
Redwood Inference
(Attachments: redwood_region_sanction_letter.pdf (DocuSign), privatelink_topology_overview.png, privatelink_runbook.pdf, CAIQ_hosting_slice.pdf, SOC2-Summary-2025.pdf)
